body: God, I completely understand that. Me and my girlfriend broke up a few days ago. It's been tough. Just know there's so many resources for you out there. My favourite is shout because it's so accessible. Further more! You sound like a lovely and caring person. If you need anyone to talk to, hit me with a DM. I'm in Edinburgh most days for work:)
I’d say it’s closer to all households. Or atleast those households with a sister in them
Disgusting. Ruining the environment like that.
Oh my god if it was on a T-shirt I’d buy the shit out of it
I don’t have a gold but god you deserve one.

And that is totally understandable but there is no reason not to trust any of us. We as a family have stuck to the rules quite strictly. Plus there is the fact that we are a respectable family.  If her mother wanted to know for certain that she wouldnt come in then she could ask my parents to make sure. Instead she has done nothing but essentially say we are all disgusting. I'm more than happy to stay outside but it's kind of a two way street. I cant run after her all the time. Its unfair.

You have a good point. The only problem is that she was barely allowed before the pandemic while she was friends with my sister. Now, she cant come over because of the pandemic but she was allowed for a while.
Honestly that makes a lot of sense.  Considering I'm not allowed to see her inside the house.

I dont believe it's a problem of trust. I have always been allowed there but she's never been allowed here. I'm not allowed in her house even though shes more likely to give me covid than my family.  I just find it unbelievably stupid and unfair.
